resources.string: Vishal Jarvis screen reader & message sender

Lets Vishal Jarvis read the text of the screen you are looking at (for example to answer a question about it, reply to a message, or fill a form with values you give), and send the message you approved inside WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram or Messenger. It never types, clicks, submits or sends anything without your confirmation.
Talk to Vishal Jarvis with one tap
